description: This file defines various interfaces related to transaction attribution grains within the Orleans framework, including extension methods and wrapper classes for different attribution options, facilitating transaction ID retrieval based on attribution behavior.

classes.name: TransactionAttributionGrainExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods to obtain transaction attribution grains based on transaction options and wrapper classes for each attribution type.

classes.name: NoAttributionGrain
classes.description: Wrapper class for INoAttributionGrain implementing ITransactionAttributionGrain.

classes.name: SuppressAttributionGrain
classes.description: Wrapper class for ISuppressAttributionGrain implementing ITransactionAttributionGrain.

classes.name: CreateOrJoinAttributionGrain
classes.description: Wrapper class for ICreateOrJoinAttributionGrain implementing ITransactionAttributionGrain.

classes.name: CreateAttributionGrain
classes.description: Wrapper class for ICreateAttributionGrain implementing ITransactionAttributionGrain.

classes.name: JoinAttributionGrain
classes.description: Wrapper class for IJoinAttributionGrain implementing ITransactionAttributionGrain.

classes.name: SupportedAttributionGrain
classes.description: Wrapper class for ISupportedAttributionGrain implementing ITransactionAttributionGrain.

classes.name: NotAllowedAttributionGrain
classes.description: Wrapper class for INotAllowedAttributionGrain implementing ITransactionAttributionGrain.

methods.name: GetTransactionAttributionGrain
methods.description: Factory extension method to retrieve appropriate attribution grain instance based on the optional TransactionOption parameter.

methods.name: GetNestedTransactionIds
methods.description: Method in the interface and wrappers to fetch nested transaction IDs based on tier and tiers list.
